name: API Freshwater Master Test Kit
description: The ubiquitous reagent master kit. Reads pH (6.0–7.6), high-range pH (7.4–8.8), ammonia (0–8 ppm), nitrite (0–5 ppm) and nitrate (0–160 ppm) by reagent drops against a colour card. Ranges are the published first/last swatch values; readings past the top swatch clamp to it.
notes: The two pH entries are the normal-range and high-range pH tests, which share the parameter but cover different swatch bands. Shake the nitrate bottle #2 hard to avoid a false low reading.
